===Objectives===
* Find and kill [[Countess Nadya]] inside the [[Regent Valley (pre-Searing)|Regent Valley]].
* See [[Lieutenant Langmar]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

== Walkthrough ==
'''Finding Nadya'''

Countess Nadya's spawn location changes with every rezone, so locating her efficiently is the first priority. There are two viable routes depending on your preference.

'''Route 1''': Starting from Fort Ranik: Enter Regent Valley from Fort Ranik and head to the southernmost marked point on the map. If she isn't there, her three remaining possible spawn locations can be checked consecutively from that point. Note that this route has less distance to cover but many more enemies to deal with.

'''Route 2''': Starting from [[Ashford Abbey]]: Exit through Ashford Abbey to Lakeside County and then Regent Valley and check the spawn locations near the portal. If she isn't there, re-enter Lakeside County through the portal and try again. While the route itself is longer, there are significantly fewer enemies to deal with along the way, making it quicker overall. Note that abandoning and retaking the quest appears to reset her spawn position.

'''Fighting Nadya'''

Once you've identified her location, pull any wandering groups of Firestarters or Raiders away before engaging. Be especially cautious of any nearby Bandit Blood Sworn, as aggroing one can aggro more surrounding Vanguard foes.
When you confront the Countess open with Firestorm and/or Backfire before closing in. Use a pet, minions, or the Fire Imp as a meatshield to absorb her powerful [[Backfire]] and [[Empathy]]. If you're lucky, she'll cast [[Shatter Delusions]] herself and inadvertently remove the hex.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Lieutenant Langmar
:''"Blasted royalists! It's a shame to see many of the most distinguished Ascalonians become nothing better than lowly bandits over political nonsense. Duke Barradin himself recognizes the legitimacy of Adelbern's rule, and still they persist in trying to hand Adelbern's crown over to the Duke.

:''We believe the former Countess Nadya is the one pulling the royalists' strings and sowing dissent among them. By order of the Ascalon Vanguard, she has been deemed a traitor and must be sent to Grenth's impending judgment. If you feel you have what it takes to complete this task, go to Regent Valley and strike her down!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = For king and country!
| decline = I don't want to get involved in your politics.
}}

=== Intermediate dialogue ===
:'''Countess Nadya''': ''"You will die for serving the false king, Adelbern!''"

==Notes==
*Similarly to all Vanguard Bounty targets, the Countess will speak the Intermediate Dialogue if you come close enough to her spawning point. If she's already dead when you do, one of the other quest-related Bandits nearby will say the dialogue instead.
*This quest occasionally spawns lone bandits near the [[portal]]s in [[Regent Valley (pre-Searing)|Regent Valley]]. This includes a spawn near [[Fort Ranik (pre-Searing)|Fort Ranik]], which will lead to the death of [[Mary Malone]].
